versos.grego: Περὶ δὲ τῶν χρόνων καὶ τῶν καιρῶν, ἀδελφοί, οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ὑμῖν γράφεσθαι·

controles.web: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
controles.kjv: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
controles.livre: Mas irmãos, acerca dos tempos e das estações, não necessitais de que eu vos escreva;

versos.grego: αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκριβῶς οἴδατε ὅτι ἡμέρα Κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης ἐν νυκτὶ οὕτως ἔρχεται.

controles.web: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
controles.kjv: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
controles.livre: pois vós mesmos bem sabeis que o dia do Senhor virá como um ladrão de noite.

versos.grego: ὅταν λέγωσιν Εἰρήνη καὶ ἀσφάλεια, τότε αἰφνίδιος αὐτοῖς ἐπίσταται ὄλεθρος ὥσπερ ἡ ὠδὶν τῇ ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσῃ, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκφύγωσιν.

controles.web: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman; and they will in no way escape.
controles.kjv: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
controles.livre: Quando disserem: “Paz e segurança”, então virá sobre eles repentina destruição, como as dores de parto da grávida, e de maneira nenhuma escaparão.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐν σκότει, ἵνα ἡ ἡμέρα ὑμᾶς ὡς κλέπτης καταλάβῃ·

controles.web: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
controles.kjv: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
controles.livre: Mas vós, irmãos, não estais em trevas, para que aquele dia vos tome de surpresa como um ladrão.

versos.grego: πάντες γὰρ ὑμεῖς υἱοὶ φωτός ἐστε καὶ υἱοὶ ἡμέρας. Οὐκ ἐσμὲν νυκτὸς οὐδὲ σκότους·

controles.web: You are all children of light, and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
controles.kjv: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
controles.livre: Todos vós sois filhos da luz e filhos do dia; não somos da noite nem das trevas.

versos.grego: ἄρα οὖν μὴ καθεύδωμεν ὡς οἱ λοιποί, ἀλλὰ γρηγορῶμεν καὶ νήφωμεν.

controles.web: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
controles.kjv: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
controles.livre: Portanto, não durmamos, como os outros; em vez disso, vigiemos e sejamos sóbrios.

versos.grego: οἱ γὰρ καθεύδοντες νυκτὸς καθεύδουσιν, καὶ οἱ μεθυσκόμενοι νυκτὸς μεθύουσιν·

controles.web: For those who sleep, sleep in the night, and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
controles.kjv: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
controles.livre: Pois os que dormem, dormem de noite; e os que ficam bêbados embebedam-se de noite.

versos.grego: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἡμέρας ὄντες νήφωμεν, ἐνδυσάμενοι θώρακα πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ περικεφαλαίαν ἐλπίδα σωτηρίας·

controles.web: But let us, since we belong to the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and, for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
controles.kjv: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
controles.livre: Mas nós, que somos do dia, sejamos sóbrios, e nos vistamos da couraça da fé e do amor, e do capacete da esperança da salvação.

versos.grego: ὅτι οὐκ ἔθετο ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς εἰς ὀργὴν ἀλλὰ εἰς περιποίησιν σωτηρίας διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
controles.kjv: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
controles.livre: Porque Deus não nos destinou para a ira, mas, sim, para obtermos a salvação, por meio do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,

versos.grego: τοῦ ἀποθανόντος περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα εἴτε γρηγορῶμεν εἴτε καθεύδωμεν ἅμα σὺν αὐτῷ ζήσωμεν.

controles.web: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
controles.kjv: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
controles.livre: que morreu por nós, a fim de que, se estivermos vigiando ou dormindo, nós vivamos juntamente com ele.

versos.grego: Διὸ παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους καὶ οἰκοδομεῖτε εἷς τὸν ἕνα, καθὼς καὶ ποιεῖτε.

controles.web: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
controles.kjv: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
controles.livre: Portanto exortai-vos uns aos outros, e edificai-vos uns aos outros, como já fazeis.

versos.grego: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, εἰδέναι τοὺς κοπιῶντας ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ προϊσταμένους ὑμῶν ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ νουθετοῦντας ὑμᾶς,

controles.web: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you,
controles.kjv: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
controles.livre: Irmãos, nós vos rogamos que reconheçais os que trabalham entre vós, e que lideram sobre vós no Senhor, e vos advertem;

versos.grego: καὶ ἡγεῖσθαι αὐτοὺς ὑπερεκπερισσῶς ἐν ἀγάπῃ διὰ τὸ ἔργον αὐτῶν. εἰρηνεύετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.

controles.web: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake.   Be at peace among yourselves.
controles.kjv: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
controles.livre: e os estimai muito com amor, por causa do trabalho deles. Tende paz entre vós.

versos.grego: Παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, νουθετεῖτε τοὺς ἀτάκτους, παραμυθεῖσθε τοὺς ὀλιγοψύχους, ἀντέχεσθε τῶν ἀσθενῶν, μακροθυμεῖτε πρὸς πάντας.

controles.web: We exhort you, brothers, admonish the disorderly, encourage the faint-hearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.
controles.kjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
controles.livre: Rogamo-vos também, irmãos, que advirtais os desordeiros, consoleis os de pouco ânimo, apoieis aos fracos, e tenhais paciência com todos.

versos.grego: ὁρᾶτε μή τις κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ τινι ἀποδῷ, ἀλλὰ πάντοτε τὸ ἀγαθὸν διώκετε εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας.

controles.web: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good, for one another, and for all.
controles.kjv: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
controles.livre: Tende cuidado para que ninguém retribua o mal com o mal, mas sempre segui o bem, tanto uns com os outros, como com todos.

versos.grego: Πάντοτε χαίρετε,

controles.web: Rejoice always.
controles.kjv: Rejoice evermore.
controles.livre: Alegrai-vos sempre.

versos.grego: ἀδιαλείπτως προσεύχεσθε,

controles.web: Pray without ceasing.
controles.kjv: Pray without ceasing.
controles.livre: Orai sem cessar.

versos.grego: ἐν παντὶ εὐχαριστεῖτε· τοῦτο γὰρ θέλημα Θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
controles.kjv: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
controles.livre: Agradecei em tudo, pois essa é a vontade de Deus em Cristo Jesus para vós mesmos.

versos.grego: τὸ Πνεῦμα μὴ σβέννυτε,

controles.web: Don’t quench the Spirit.
controles.kjv: Quench not the Spirit.
controles.livre: Não apagueis o Espírito.

versos.grego: προφητείας μὴ ἐξουθενεῖτε·

controles.web: Don’t despise prophesies.
controles.kjv: Despise not prophesyings.
controles.livre: Não desprezeis as profecias.

versos.grego: πάντα δὲ δοκιμάζετε, τὸ καλὸν κατέχετε·

controles.web: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
controles.kjv: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
controles.livre: Examinai tudo, e mantende o que é bom.

versos.grego: ἀπὸ παντὸς εἴδους πονηροῦ ἀπέχεσθε.

controles.web: Abstain from every form of evil.
controles.kjv: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
controles.livre: Não haja entre vós qualquer forma de mal.

versos.grego: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἁγιάσαι ὑμᾶς ὁλοτελεῖς, καὶ ὁλόκληρον ὑμῶν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ καὶ τὸ σῶμα ἀμέμπτως ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τηρηθείη.

controles.web: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: E o próprio Deus da paz vos santifique em tudo; e que todo o vosso espírito, alma e corpo sejam preservados irrepreensíveis na vinda do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: πιστὸς ὁ καλῶν ὑμᾶς, ὃς καὶ ποιήσει.

controles.web: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
controles.kjv: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
controles.livre: Fiel é aquele que vos chama, e ele também o fará.

versos.grego: Ἀδελφοί, προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν.

controles.web: Brothers, pray for us.
controles.kjv: Brethren, pray for us.
controles.livre: Irmãos, orai por nós.

versos.grego: Ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς πάντας ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ.

controles.web: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
controles.kjv: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
controles.livre: Saudai a todos os irmãos com beijo santo.

versos.grego: Ἐνορκίζω ὑμᾶς τὸν Κύριον ἀναγνωσθῆναι τὴν ἐπιστολὴν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς.

controles.web: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
controles.kjv: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
controles.livre: Eu vos mando pelo Senhor que esta carta seja lida a todos os irmãos.

versos.grego: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθ’ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
controles.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.  The first epistle unto the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
controles.livre: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja convosco.
